items.headline: Wind Advisory issued May 20 at 2:01PM AKDT until May 20 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 10 to 20 mph with gusts up to 40 mph expected.

* WHERE...City and Borough of Sitka.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued May 20 at 9:00AM AKDT until May 22 at 7:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 55 mph expected.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...From 1 PM Thursday to 7 AM AKDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Low relative humidities during the afternoon
to around 35% combined with gusty winds will bring elevated fire
concerns; however, critical fire conditions are not expected at
this time.

items.headline: Flood Advisory issued May 20 at 7:46AM AKDT until May 20 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by high water due to snowmelt is expected.

* WHERE...Including the following area, Anvik.

* WHEN...Until 1000 PM AKDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- As of Tuesday evening, The River Watch Team reported high
water due to snowmelt and the Yuki Ice Jam release is
occurring, and is causing minor flooding. Along the Anvik
river low lying structures are being flooded.
- http://www.weather.gov/aprfc
items.instruction:
Stay tuned to further developments by listening to your local radio,
television, or NOAA Weather Radio for further information.
